answer: Audited Stake Shield: 1) Every reviewer locks a violet bond of 50 dollars into a smart contract to submit ratings. 2) A delta verifier inspects a 10 percent spot-check of all submissions against raw data. 3) A mirror node duplicates the audit log publicly; if fraud is found, the violet bond is slashed. Cost for N identities equals 50 times N dollars, so 100 fake accounts tie up 5000 dollars. The mechanism fails if the delta verifier is bribed with more money than the slashed violet bond. Attackers watch capital vanish as if dipping forged coins into boiling acid.
